channel.title: Statewide: Upcoming Mass Gatherings
channel.description: Large upcoming events that may raise EMS call volume and hospital demand. Updated weekly. Each item shows a confidence level for its attendance figure.

item.title: [Rural] Hauntober, Virginia City (Storey County), Oct 1-31, 2026 (Attendance figures unable to confirm)
item.description: No attendance figure found. The month-long event runs through Halloween weekend in a town of 787 residents (2020 Census), so a 500-person crowd would pass the 25 percent rule. Expect crowded C Street, steep and uneven walking surfaces, saloon crowds with intoxication-related calls, and slower ambulance access. (Attendance figures unable to confirm)

item.title: [Rural] Beatty Days, Beatty (Nye County), Oct 30-Nov 1, 2026 (Confidence: Moderate)
item.description: The Chamber of Commerce estimated about 600 people over 3 days at last year's event, per the Pahrump Valley Times. No 2026 figure yet. Beatty has 880 residents (2020 Census), so 600 people is about 68 percent of the town and meets the 25 percent rule. Expect strain on the town's clinic and ambulance coverage, and crowded roads and restaurants. (Confidence: Moderate)

item.title: [Rural] Nevada Day Parade, Carson City (Carson City), Oct 31, 2026 (Attendance figures unable to confirm)
item.description: No 2026 attendance figure found. The organizer says the parade draws tens of thousands of spectators each year, but gives no count. Carson City has 58,639 residents (2020 Census). A large crowd in a small city can strain the local ED and EMS. Expect crowded downtown streets and slower ambulance access. (Attendance figures unable to confirm)

item.title: [Clark] SEMA Show, Las Vegas (Clark County), Nov 3-6, 2026 (Confidence: Moderate)
item.description: SEMA lists 153,000+ total attendees over 4 days, including 70,000+ buyers. Trade press reports the same figure as the 2026 expectation. The SEMA page does not date the figure. Expect more routine traveler medical calls, busier EDs, rideshare and taxi shortages, and crowded restaurants. (Confidence: Moderate)

item.title: [Washoe] Nevada Wolf Pack vs. New Mexico at Mackay Stadium, Reno (Washoe County), Nov 7, 2026 (Confidence: Moderate)
item.description: Last season's average home crowd was about 17,875 for 1 day (six 2025 home games, 107,248 total announced attendance, averaged from the Wikipedia game log). No 2026 figure yet. Expect more routine traveler medical calls, busier EDs near the university, crowded restaurants, and rideshare and taxi shortages after the game. (Confidence: Moderate)

item.title: [Clark] Raiders vs. Seahawks at Allegiant Stadium, Las Vegas (Clark County), Nov 15, 2026 (Confidence: Moderate)
item.description: Venue capacity is about 65,000 for 1 day. NFL games use about 62,500 fixed seats, per Las Vegas Stadium Authority documents reported by the Review-Journal. This is venue capacity, not a game count. It falls the day before RE+ begins and four days before Grand Prix week. Expect more routine traveler medical calls, busier EDs near the stadium, and rideshare and taxi shortages after the game. Restaurants will be crowded. (Confidence: Moderate)

item.title: [Clark] RE+ Solar and Clean Energy Show, Las Vegas (Clark County), Nov 16-19, 2026 (Confidence: Moderate)
item.description: About 39,000 attendees in total over 4 days, per an Exhibit City News calendar. That figure is for last year's show. No 2026 figure found. Expect more routine traveler medical calls, busier EDs, and rideshare and taxi shortages near the Convention Center. (Confidence: Moderate)

item.title: [Clark] Las Vegas Grand Prix (Formula 1), Las Vegas (Clark County), Nov 19-21, 2026 (Confidence: Moderate)
item.description: Organizers said last year's race drew more than 300,000 fans in total over 3 days. No 2026 figure yet. Police counted far fewer in 2024, so treat the total as an organizer claim. Expect road closures near the Strip, delayed ambulance transport, more intoxication and cold night exposure calls, and rideshare and taxi shortages. (Confidence: Moderate)

item.title: [Rural] Pahrump Social Pow Wow, Pahrump (Nye County), Nov 20-22, 2026 (Confidence: Moderate)
item.description: The Pahrump Valley Times reported about 2,000 people over 3 days at an earlier edition. The year was not stated. No 2026 figure yet, and this is borderline for the Rural threshold. The event is free at Petrack Park. Expect more routine traveler medical calls, cold evening exposure, and busier ambulance and clinic demand in Pahrump. (Confidence: Moderate)

item.title: [Clark] Neon City Festival, Las Vegas (Clark County), Nov 20-22, 2026 (Attendance figures unable to confirm)
item.description: No attendance figure found. The free, all-ages music festival spans about five downtown blocks and overlaps Grand Prix weekend. Expect crowded Fremont Street, more intoxication and cold night exposure calls, delayed ambulance access, and rideshare and taxi shortages. (Attendance figures unable to confirm)

item.title: [Clark] AWS re:Invent, Las Vegas (Clark County), Nov 30-Dec 4, 2026 (Confidence: Moderate)
item.description: Third-party reports put last year's (2025) show at more than 60,000 in-person attendees over 5 days. AWS's own security blog cited more than 54,000 for 2024. AWS has not published a 2026 figure or a 2025 count. Expect more routine traveler medical calls, busier EDs, rideshare and taxi shortages, and crowded restaurants near the Strip. (Confidence: Moderate)

item.title: [Clark] National Finals Rodeo, Las Vegas (Clark County), Dec 3-12, 2026 (Confidence: Moderate)
item.description: Last year's official total was 175,846 over 10 performances, about 17,584 per night. Cowboy Christmas and a hunting expo drew 347,571 combined at the Convention Center South Halls in 2025. No 2026 figure yet. Expect nightly crowds at the Thomas & Mack Center, more traveler medical calls and intoxication, busier EDs, and rideshare and taxi shortages near UNLV and the Strip. (Confidence: Moderate)

item.title: [Clark] Jason Aldean and Luke Bryan Double Down Tour at Allegiant Stadium, Las Vegas (Clark County), Dec 11, 2026 (Attendance figures unable to confirm)
item.description: No attendance figure found. The venue lists the date and openers only. Stadium concerts of this size can pass the Clark threshold, so the event is included. Expect more routine traveler medical calls, intoxication calls, busier EDs near the stadium, and rideshare and taxi shortages after the show. It falls during the National Finals Rodeo run. (Attendance figures unable to confirm)

item.title: [Washoe] Reno Santa Crawl, Reno (Washoe County), Dec 12, 2026 (Confidence: Moderate)
item.description: Alcohol-centered, half threshold applied. Travel Nevada promotes more than 20,000 holiday revelers for 1 evening (8 pm to midnight). This is a state tourism listing, not an organizer or police count. Older Reno Police projections ran near 15,000. Expect intoxication, falls, assaults and impaired driving calls, busier downtown EDs, and rideshare and taxi shortages. (Confidence: Moderate)
